column1: # The #25 ladders, one row per rung (#51; docs/ladder.md, "The lever table"). Read by
# scripts/lib/ladder_levers.py (make ladder-check), scripts/g3/mkspec-ladder.sh and, by column name,
#   rung; arm (S: ladder 1, upstream; O: ladder 2, ours); predecessor (- for the root S0-T1);
#   status (run, or not-run: <reason>: kept for the record, never generated, and no rung's predecessor);
#   lever (what the tables report: the key-group; stock for S0-T1, threads for S0-Tv, IN_DEST for S2c, host-tunes for S3, rapidgzip for S5);
#   group (the key-group the one-lever check compares; - for the root);
#   coupled (KEY+KEY: why each also changes with the lever; empty if none);
#   counterpart (the rung on the other ladder, or "none: reason");
#   endpoint (c<cohort>:<endpoint>;...: each (cohort, endpoint) declared on exactly one rung, before any run);
#   pred_wall_s, pred_usd, pred_phase_s (predicted deltas at cohort 1 where a measured rate gives one; the note names it);
#   instance (=pred: the predecessor's); az; ttl_min_c1 (TTL at cohort 1; other cohorts pass TTL= to the generator);
# Placeholders (@probe-tune, @select:<rung>[:<KEY>]) are unresolved; the generator refuses any rung
# that still has one. scripts/g3/ladder.resolved.tsv (absent until a selection is made) resolves
# them per cohort, each with the results/ file it comes from.
